# Differential Gene Expression Analysis 

This analysis is to look at differential expression between GF and SPF mice and then to look at recovery of gene expression in the minimally diverse MM12 mice.

Having established that there is probably some sampling biases in the data we add PC1 and PC2 into the ileum model to control for unmeasured variation.


```{r setup}

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/well/powrie/users/utu691/work/Diversity_Transcriptome/")

```

```{r define comparisons, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# Define comparisons
comparisons <- list(
  list(name = "Liver_SPF_vs_GF", txi = liver_txi_spf_vs_gf, metadata = liver_metadata_spf_vs_gf, title = "Liver: SPF vs GF", design_formula = ~ status),
  list(name = "Liver_SPF_vs_MM12", txi = liver_txi_spf_vs_mm12, metadata = liver_metadata_spf_vs_mm12, title = "Liver: SPF vs MM12", design_formula = ~ status),
  list(name = "Liver_GF_vs_MM12", txi = liver_txi_gf_vs_mm12, metadata = liver_metadata_gf_vs_mm12, title = "Liver: GF vs MM12", design_formula = ~ status),
  list(name = "Ileum_SPF_vs_GF", txi = ileum_txi_spf_vs_gf, metadata = ileum_metadata_spf_vs_gf, title = "Ileum: SPF vs GF", design_formula = ~ PC1 + PC2 + status),
  list(name = "Ileum_SPF_vs_MM12", txi = ileum_txi_spf_vs_mm12, metadata = ileum_metadata_spf_vs_mm12, title = "Ileum: SPF vs MM12", design_formula = ~ PC1 + PC2 + status),
  list(name = "Ileum_GF_vs_MM12", txi = ileum_txi_gf_vs_mm12, metadata = ileum_metadata_gf_vs_mm12, title = "Ileum: GF vs MM12", design_formula = ~ PC1 + PC2 + status)
)

# For offline mode (no internet required)
results <- run_full_analysis(comparisons, offline = TRUE)
saveRDS(results, file = "export.dir/results.Rds")

```

## PCA in each tissue across groups

First we are exploring overall differences if the microbiome is not present i.e. GF vs. SPF.

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height= 10, fig.width= 10}

liver_pc <- runPCA(liver_normed_dat[, grep("^Liver(1[0-5]|[1-9]|7[6-9]|8[0-9]|90)$", colnames(liver_normed_dat))], scale=FALSE)
ileum_pc <- runPCA(ileum_normed_dat_corrected[, grep("^Ileum(1[0-5]|[1-9]|7[6-9]|8[0-9]|90)$", colnames(ileum_normed_dat_corrected))], scale=FALSE)

liver_colours <- group_colours[1:2]
names(liver_colours) <- c("GF", "SPF")

liver_PCA <- plotPrincipalComponentsCustom(
  liver_pc, 
  liver_metadata[grep("^Liver(1[0-5]|[1-9]|7[6-9]|8[0-9]|90)$", liver_metadata$sampleID), ], 
  group = 'status', 
  colourby ='status')  + 
  stat_ellipse() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = liver_colours)


ileum_PCA <- plotPrincipalComponentsCustom(
  ileum_pc, 
  ileum_metadata[grep("^Ileum(1[0-5]|[1-9]|7[6-9]|8[0-9]|90)$", ileum_metadata$sampleID), ], 
  group = 'status', 
  colourby ='status')  + 
  stat_ellipse() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours)

# save pca plots for figures
if(!(dir.exists("export.dir"))){
  dir.create("export.dir")
}

ggsave(ileum_PCA, file = "export.dir/ileum_spf_gf_pca.pdf", 
       height = 2.5,
       width = 2.5)

ggsave(liver_PCA, file = "export.dir/liver_spf_gf_pca.pdf", 
       height = 2.5,
       width = 2.5)

gridExtra::grid.arrange(ileum_PCA, liver_PCA, nrow = 1)

```

```{r tables set up, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 10}
       height = 3,

       file = "export.dir/liver_spf_gf_pathways.pdf",
       height = 3,
       width = 4.5)

create_tissue_table <- function(pathways_df, title = NULL) {
  selected_cols <- c("Enriched_in", "pathway", "NES", "padj", "size")
  formatted <- pathways_df[, ..selected_cols]
  setnames(formatted, "Enriched_in", "Enriched in")
  formatted$NES <- round(formatted$NES, 3)
  formatted$padj <- formatC(formatted$padj, format = "e", digits = 2)
  formatted <- formatted[order(`Enriched in`)]

  knitr::kable(formatted, caption = title, format = "pandoc")
}

grid.arrange(ileum_top_pathways, liver_top_pathways, nrow = 2)

```

## Genes of interest - ileum

Here we focus on genes of interest that have come out of the Shen paper and that come up in our enrichment analysis - it should cover some of the immune/plasma cell development and activation and the lipid metabolic pathways.

```{r genes of interest, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}


spf_gf_meta <- ileum_metadata[grep("^Ileum(1[0-5]|[1-9]|7[6-9]|8[0-9]|90)$", ileum_metadata$sampleID), ]
rownames(spf_gf_meta) <- spf_gf_meta$sampleID

spf_gf_mat <- ileum_normed_dat_corrected[,spf_gf_meta$sampleID]
            
# get the GOIs
plasma <- c(results$Ileum_SPF_vs_GF$symbol_to_ensembl[["Igha"]],
            results$Ileum_SPF_vs_GF$symbol_to_ensembl[["Ighg2b"]])

b_cell_activation <- c(results$Ileum_SPF_vs_GF$symbol_to_ensembl[["Hspa1a"]],
            results$Ileum_SPF_vs_GF$symbol_to_ensembl[["Hspa1b"]])

il7 <- c(results$Ileum_SPF_vs_GF$symbol_to_ensembl[["Il7"]],
            results$Ileum_SPF_vs_GF$symbol_to_ensembl[["Il7r"]])

apoas <- c(results$Ileum_SPF_vs_GF$symbol_to_ensembl[["Apoa1"]],
            results$Ileum_SPF_vs_GF$symbol_to_ensembl[["Apoa4"]])

transport <- c(results$Ileum_SPF_vs_GF$symbol_to_ensembl[["Fabp1"]],
            results$Ileum_SPF_vs_GF$symbol_to_ensembl[["Fabp2"]]) 

spf_gf_gois <- spf_gf_mat[c(plasma, b_cell_activation, il7, apoas, transport),]
rownames(spf_gf_gois) <- c("Igha", "Ighg2b", "Hspa1a", "Hspa1b", "Il7", "Il7r", "Apoa1", "Apoa4", "Fabp1", "Fabp2")

for (i in 1:nrow(spf_gf_gois)){
    featurebox(as.data.frame(spf_gf_gois),
           metadata = spf_gf_meta,
           features = rownames(spf_gf_gois)[i],
           group_by = "status")  +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    scale_color_manual(values = group_colours) +
    facet_wrap(~feature, scales = "free", ncol = 2)
    ggsave(file = paste0("export.dir/", rownames(spf_gf_gois)[i], ".pdf"), height = 2.5, width = 2.5)
}

```

## Recovery of gene expression in MM12

Here we assess the ability of colonisation of a minimally diverse microbiome to recover gene expression patterns seen in SPF.

### PCA

```{r recovery, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height= 10, fig.width= 10}

liver_pc <- runPCA(liver_normed_dat, scale=FALSE)
ileum_pc <- runPCA(ileum_normed_dat_corrected[, grep("^Ileum(1[0-5]|[1-9]|6[1-9]|7[0-5]|7[6-9]|8[0-9]|90)$", colnames(ileum_normed_dat_corrected))], scale=FALSE)


liver_samples <- grep("^Liver(1[0-5]|[1-9]|6[1-9]|7[0-5]|7[6-9]|8[0-9]|90)$", liver_metadata$sampleID)
liver_dist <- dist(t(liver_normed_dat[, liver_samples]))
adonis_test_liver <- adonis2(liver_dist ~ status, data = liver_metadata[liver_samples, ])

ileum_samples <- grep("^Ileum(1[0-5]|[1-9]|6[1-9]|7[0-5]|7[6-9]|8[0-9]|90)$", ileum_metadata$sampleID)
ileum_dist <- dist(t(ileum_normed_dat_corrected[, ileum_samples]))
adonis_test_ileum <- adonis2(ileum_dist ~ status, data = ileum_metadata[ileum_samples, ])

liver_colours <- group_colours[1:3]
names(liver_colours) <- c("GF", "SPF", "MM12")
liver_PCA <- plotPrincipalComponentsCustom(
  liver_pc, 
  liver_metadata[liver_samples, ], 
  group = 'status', 
  colourby ='status') +
  stat_ellipse() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = liver_colours)

ileum_PCA <- plotPrincipalComponentsCustom(
  ileum_pc, 
  ileum_metadata[ileum_samples, ], 
  group = 'status', 
  colourby ='status') +
  stat_ellipse() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_colours)

ggsave(ileum_PCA, file = "export.dir/ileum_spf_gf_mm12_pca.pdf", 
       height = 2.5,
       width = 2.5)

ggsave(liver_PCA, file = "export.dir/liver_spf_gf_mm12_pca.pdf", 
       height = 2.5,
       width = 2.5)  

gridExtra::grid.arrange(ileum_PCA, liver_PCA, nrow = 1)
```


### Recovery numbers

```{r recovery numbers and genes, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

# Extract individual DESeq2 results from the results list
liver_res_spf_vs_gf <- results[["Liver_SPF_vs_GF"]]$deseq
liver_res_spf_vs_mm12 <- results[["Liver_SPF_vs_MM12"]]$deseq
liver_res_gf_vs_mm12 <- results[["Liver_GF_vs_MM12"]]$deseq
ileum_res_spf_vs_gf <- results[["Ileum_SPF_vs_GF"]]$deseq
ileum_res_spf_vs_mm12 <- results[["Ileum_SPF_vs_MM12"]]$deseq
ileum_res_gf_vs_mm12 <- results[["Ileum_GF_vs_MM12"]]$deseq


# Extracting significantly upregulated genes
liver_spf_vs_gf_up <- liver_res_spf_vs_gf$log2FoldChange < 0 & liver_res_spf_vs_gf$padj < 0.05
liver_spf_vs_mm12_up <- liver_res_spf_vs_mm12$log2FoldChange < 0 & liver_res_spf_vs_mm12$padj < 0.05
liver_gf_vs_mm12_up <- liver_res_gf_vs_mm12$log2FoldChange < 0 & liver_res_gf_vs_mm12$padj < 0.05
ileum_spf_vs_gf_up <- ileum_res_spf_vs_gf$log2FoldChange < 0 & ileum_res_spf_vs_gf$padj < 0.05
ileum_spf_vs_mm12_up <- ileum_res_spf_vs_mm12$log2FoldChange < 0 & ileum_res_spf_vs_mm12$padj < 0.05
ileum_gf_vs_mm12_up <- ileum_res_gf_vs_mm12$log2FoldChange < 0 & ileum_res_gf_vs_mm12$padj < 0.05

# Extracting significantly downregulated genes
liver_spf_vs_gf_down <- liver_res_spf_vs_gf$log2FoldChange > 0 & liver_res_spf_vs_gf$padj < 0.05
liver_spf_vs_mm12_down <- liver_res_spf_vs_mm12$log2FoldChange > 0 & liver_res_spf_vs_mm12$padj < 0.05
liver_gf_vs_mm12_down <- liver_res_gf_vs_mm12$log2FoldChange > 0 & liver_res_gf_vs_mm12$padj < 0.05
ileum_spf_vs_gf_down <- ileum_res_spf_vs_gf$log2FoldChange > 0 & ileum_res_spf_vs_gf$padj < 0.05
ileum_spf_vs_mm12_down <- ileum_res_spf_vs_mm12$log2FoldChange > 0 & ileum_res_spf_vs_mm12$padj < 0.05
ileum_gf_vs_mm12_down <- ileum_res_gf_vs_mm12$log2FoldChange > 0 & ileum_res_gf_vs_mm12$padj < 0.05


# Extracting gene names or IDs
liver_spf_vs_gf_up_genes <- rownames(liver_res_spf_vs_gf)[liver_spf_vs_gf_up]
liver_spf_vs_mm12_up_genes <- rownames(liver_res_spf_vs_mm12)[liver_spf_vs_mm12_up]
liver_gf_vs_mm12_up_genes <- rownames(liver_res_gf_vs_mm12)[liver_gf_vs_mm12_up]
ileum_spf_vs_gf_up_genes <- rownames(ileum_res_spf_vs_gf)[ileum_spf_vs_gf_up]
ileum_spf_vs_mm12_up_genes <- rownames(ileum_res_spf_vs_mm12)[ileum_spf_vs_mm12_up]

liver_spf_vs_gf_down_genes <- rownames(liver_res_spf_vs_gf)[liver_spf_vs_gf_down]
```

## Simple pathway analysis of recovered or not recovered

### Ileum

```{r pathways recovery status, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

pathways <- fgsea::gmtPathways( "/well/powrie/shared/mm_msigdb/m5.go.v2023.1.Mm.symbols.gmt.txt")
pathways <- pathways[grep("GOBP", names(pathways))]

pathway_fold_enrichment <- function(res, nsig, pathways, universe){
  
  # iterate over pathways and estimate fold changes
  for (i in 1:nrow(res)){
    pathway <- res[i, "pathway"]
    pathway_set <- unlist(pathways[[pathway]])
    background_overlap <- length(intersect(universe, pathway_set))
    overlap <- res[i, "overlap"]
    fe <- (overlap/nsig)/(background_overlap/length(universe))
    res[i, "foldEnrichment"] <- fe
  }
  return(res)
}

ileum_up_recovered_path <- pathway_fold_enrichment(as.data.frame(fgsea::fora(pathways,
                                       ileum_recovery_genes$up_recovered,
                                       universe = unlist(ileum_recovery_genes, use.names = FALSE))),
                                       length(ileum_recovery_genes$up_recovered),
                                       pathways,
                                       unlist(ileum_recovery_genes, use.names = FALSE))

ileum_down_recovered_path <- pathway_fold_enrichment(as.data.frame(fgsea::fora(pathways,
                                       ileum_recovery_genes$down_recovered,
                                       universe = unlist(ileum_recovery_genes, use.names = FALSE))),
                                       length(ileum_recovery_genes$down_recovered),
                                       pathways,
                                       unlist(ileum_recovery_genes, use.names = FALSE))

ileum_up_notrecovered_path <- pathway_fold_enrichment(as.data.frame(fgsea::fora(pathways,
                                       ileum_recovery_genes$up_not_recovered,
                                       universe = unlist(ileum_recovery_genes, use.names = FALSE))),
                                       length(ileum_recovery_genes$up_not_recovered),
                                       pathways,
                                       unlist(ileum_recovery_genes, use.names = FALSE))                                 

ileum_down_notrecovered_path <- pathway_fold_enrichment(as.data.frame(fgsea::fora(pathways,
                                       ileum_recovery_genes$down_not_recovered,
                                       universe = unlist(ileum_recovery_genes, use.names = FALSE))),
                                       length(ileum_recovery_genes$down_not_recovered),
                                       pathways,
                                       unlist(ileum_recovery_genes, use.names = FALSE))      

# order
ileum_up_recovered_path <- ileum_up_recovered_path[ileum_up_recovered_path$padj < 0.05 & order(ileum_up_recovered_path$foldEnrichment, decreasing = TRUE),]

ileum_down_recovered_path <- ileum_down_recovered_path[ileum_down_recovered_path$padj < 0.05 & order(ileum_down_recovered_path$foldEnrichment, decreasing = TRUE),]

ileum_up_notrecovered_path <- ileum_up_notrecovered_path[ileum_up_notrecovered_path$padj < 0.05 & order(ileum_up_notrecovered_path$foldEnrichment, decreasing = TRUE),]

ileum_down_notrecovered_path <- ileum_down_notrecovered_path[ileum_down_notrecovered_path$padj < 0.05 & order(ileum_down_notrecovered_path$foldEnrichment, decreasing = TRUE),]

# take top one from each
to_plot_pathways <- data.frame(pathway = c(ileum_up_recovered_path$pathway[1],
                                           ileum_down_recovered_path$pathway[1],
                                           ileum_up_notrecovered_path$pathway[1],
                                           ileum_down_notrecovered_path$pathway[1]),
                               FoldEnrichment = c(ileum_up_recovered_path$foldEnrichment[1],
                                           ileum_down_recovered_path$foldEnrichment[1],
                                           ileum_up_notrecovered_path$foldEnrichment[1],
                                           ileum_down_notrecovered_path$foldEnrichment[1]),
                               Status = c("Up recovered",
                                          "Down recovered",
                                          "Up not recovered",
                                          "Down not recovered"))
to_plot_pathways$pathway <- factor(to_plot_pathways$pathway, levels = to_plot_pathways$pathway)
ggplot(to_plot_pathways, aes(x = pathway, y = FoldEnrichment, fill = Status)) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity") +
  theme_classic() +
  coord_flip() +
  ylim(c(0,3)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey", "snow2", "grey", "snow2")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
  
ggsave("export.dir/Ileum_recovery_pathways_barplot.pdf", height = 2.5, width = 5)
```

## Liver visualisation of results

I think we want to finish with the observation that lipid metabolic processes are also affected in the liver and therefore may be influenced by ileum or other intestinal segments in GF vs SPF. Whether or not the MM12 can recover these pathways in the liver is also of interest given that Fabl1 etc were not recovered in the ileum. It could be quite a nice message that this minial community does not recover ileum-liver communication to a full extent based on lipid metabolic processes.

## The numbers

```{r numbers up and down liver, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

liver_mm12 <- results$Liver_SPF_vs_MM12$deseq
liver_gf <- results$Liver_SPF_vs_GF$deseq

up_mm12 <- subset(liver_mm12, subset = padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0)
down_mm12 <- subset(liver_mm12, subset = padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0)

up_gf <- subset(liver_gf, subset = padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < 0)
down_gf <- subset(liver_gf, subset = padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0)

                            down_mm12 = nrow(down_mm12),
```

## Correlation between lipid metabolism in ileum and lipid response in the liver

Here we create a metagene (pathway metagene) for ileum (GOBP lipid metabolism) and liver (GOBP response to lipid) to see if we get any correlation both between and within groups of mice.

```{r lipid things, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}

lipid_metabolic_process <- unlist(results$Ileum_SPF_vs_GF$gsea[results$Ileum_SPF_vs_GF$gsea$pathway == "GOBP_LIPID_METABOLIC_PROCESS",]$leadingEdge)

#lipid_metabolic_process <- unlist(pathways["GOBP_LIPID_METABOLIC_PROCESS"], use.names = FALSE)
response_to_lipid <-  unlist(results$Liver_SPF_vs_GF$gsea[results$Liver_SPF_vs_GF$gsea$pathway == "GOBP_RESPONSE_TO_LIPID",]$leadingEdge)
  
lipid_metabolic_process_ileum <- colMeans(ileum_exprs[lipid_metabolic_process,], na.rm = TRUE)
response_to_lipid_liver <- colMeans(liver_exprs[response_to_lipid,], na.rm = TRUE)

names(lipid_metabolic_process_ileum) <- gsub("Ileum", "Sample", names(lipid_metabolic_process_ileum))
names(response_to_lipid_liver) <- gsub("Liver", "Sample", names(response_to_lipid_liver))

samples <- names(lipid_metabolic_process_ileum)

to_cor_lipid <- data.frame(sample = samples,
                           Liver_Metagene = response_to_lipid_liver[samples],
                           Ileum_Metagene = lipid_metabolic_process_ileum[samples],
                           group = ileum_metadata[colnames(ileum_exprs),]$status)

p_cor <- ggplot(to_cor_lipid, aes(x = Ileum_Metagene, y = Liver_Metagene, color = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_classic() +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(blues9[3], blues9[5], blues9[7])) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(blues9[3], blues9[5], blues9[7])) +
  stat_smooth(data = to_cor_lipid, aes(x = Ileum_Metagene, y = Liver_Metagene), inherit.aes = FALSE, method = "lm", linetype = "dashed", color = "black", se = FALSE) +
  stat_cor(data = to_cor_lipid, aes(x = Ileum_Metagene, y = Liver_Metagene), inherit.aes = FALSE) 

ggsave(p_cor + theme(legend.position = "none"), 
       file = "export.dir/lipid_cors_across_tissues.pdf",
       height = 2.5, width = 2.5)

```

There is no correlation within groups so rather than quantitative changes it looks more like physiological shifts due to microbiome background.
